name: Wildbend River
summary: Near the Grove of the Ancients, Wildbend River carries demonic poison toward the sea. Its tainted waters run through southern Darkshore from the corrupted heights of Felwood, endangering the wilderness.

sections.title: A Toxic Mountain Stream
sections.body: Wildbend River brings corruption, not clean nourishment, to southern Darkshore. It flows west past the Grove of the Ancients and empties into the sea. The river continues from Felwood's Bloodvenom River, tumbling through rocky ridges with foul runoff. Night elves watch its banks for twisted wildlife and the spread of demonic blight.

faq.q: Why is the Wildbend River corrupted?
faq.answer: Wildbend River begins high in Felwood's mountains, where it is called the Bloodvenom River. Demonic magic saturated Felwood during the Third War, and foul runoff spills down the cliffs into Darkshore.
The river descends from the eastern ridges between Felwood and Darkshore. It winds through southern Darkshore near the Grove of the Ancients, then flows into the Veiled Sea.

faq.q: Does the river affect the Grove of the Ancients?
faq.answer: Wildbend River passes close to the Grove of the Ancients, threatening the ancient protectors rooted there. Night elves work tirelessly to contain the blight and keep the poisoned water from rotting the sacred groves.

angles.text: For night elf wardens, the riverbanks are a frequent concern as polluted water from Felwood threatens Darkshore's ancient roots.
Druids study the ecological aftermath of the Third War and watch how deeply Felwood's corruption reaches the plants and animals downstream.
